blueprint.name: IBM ROKS Cluster Provisioning
blueprint.description: Create an IBM ROKS cluster backed by an existing COS instance, emit BNK registration outputs, install cert-manager and the F5 Lifecycle Operator, deploy a CNEInstance, and apply the BNK License.

outcomes: An IBM ROKS cluster is created
The cluster registry uses an existing COS instance referenced by name
Cluster outputs are available for BNK managed-cluster registration
cert-manager is installed in the new cluster and its CRDs are registered
F5 Lifecycle Operator (FLO) is installed and bound to an IBM IAM trusted profile
A CNEInstance is deployed and its TMM/Helm pods reach Ready
A BNK License CR is applied to the cluster using the JWT stored in IBM COS

prerequisites.description: The modules/roks-cluster-create, modules/roks-cluster-install-cert-manager, modules/roks-cluster-install-flo, modules/roks-cluster-cneinstall, and modules/roks-cluster-license deployment packs from this repository must already be synced into Forge.

prerequisites.name: ibmcloud_api_key
prerequisites.description: Provide an IBM Cloud credential template or project secret that can supply the IBM Cloud API key.

input_summary.label: Input guidance
input_summary.value: Provide IBM Cloud API key, region, resource group, the desired cluster name, the existing COS instance name (used for both the cluster registry and FLO's FAR auth key + JWT), and BIG-IP CIS controller credentials.

required.name: ibmcloud_api_key
required.description: IBM Cloud API key for cluster provisioning.

required.name: ibmcloud_cluster_region
required.description: IBM Cloud region for the ROKS cluster.

required.name: roks_cluster_name
required.description: Name of the IBM ROKS cluster to create.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resource_group
optional.description: IBM Cloud resource group used by the deployment. Defaults to the value inherited from the selected IBM Cloud Credential Template, or 'default' if none is provided.

optional.name: workers_per_zone
optional.description: Number of worker nodes per zone. OpenShift clusters typically require at least 2 workers per zone.

optional.name: openshift_cluster_version
optional.description: Desired OpenShift major.minor version.

optional.name: min_worker_vcpu_count
optional.description: Minimum worker vCPU count.

optional.name: min_worker_memory_gb
optional.description: Minimum worker memory in GB.

optional.name: worker_flavor
optional.description: Optional explicit worker flavor override.

optional.name: cluster_vpc_name
optional.description: Optional VPC name override.

optional.name: cluster_vpc_cidr
optional.description: Base CIDR for the created cluster VPC.

optional.name: zones
optional.description: Optional explicit zone list.

optional.name: cert_manager_namespace
optional.description: Kubernetes namespace for cert-manager.

optional.name: cert_manager_version
optional.description: cert-manager Helm chart version.

optional.name: f5_bigip_k8s_manifest_version
optional.description: Version of the f5-bigip-k8s-manifest chart (FLO/CIS versions are extracted from this).

optional.name: flo_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for F5 Lifecycle Operator.

optional.name: flo_utils_namespace
optional.description: Namespace for F5 utility components.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_bucket_region
optional.description: IBM Cloud region where the COS bucket is located.

optional.name: ibmcloud_cos_instance_name
optional.description: Name of the existing IBM COS instance used by the cluster registry and the FLO FAR auth key/JWT.

optional.name: ibmcloud_resources_cos_bucket
optional.description: IBM Cloud COS bucket containing the FAR auth key and JWT files.

optional.name: bigip_url
optional.description: BIG-IP URL used by the FLO CIS controller.

optional.name: bigip_username
optional.description: BIG-IP username used by the FLO CIS controller.

optional.name: bigip_password
optional.description: BIG-IP password used by the FLO CIS controller.

optional.name: far_repo_url
optional.description: FAR Repository URL for Docker and Helm registry.

optional.name: f5_cne_far_auth_file
optional.description: FAR auth key filename in the COS bucket (.tgz).

optional.name: nad_cni_type
optional.description: CNI type for NAD (host-device or ipvlan).

optional.name: nad_interface_name
optional.description: Network interface name for NAD.

optional.name: nad_ipvlan_mode
optional.description: IPVLAN mode (l2 or l3) — only used when nad_cni_type is ipvlan.

optional.name: cneinstance_deployment_size
optional.description: Deployment size for CNEInstance (Small, Medium, Large).

optional.name: cneinstance_gslb_datacenter_name
optional.description: GSLB datacenter name for CNEInstance (optional).

optional.name: cneinstance_network_attachments
optional.description: Multus Network Attachment Definitions for the CNEInstance TMM deployments.

optional.name: f5_cne_subscription_jwt_file
optional.description: Subscription JWT filename in the COS bucket (used by the License module).

optional.name: license_mode
optional.description: License operation mode (connected or disconnected).

modules.name: ROKS Cluster Create
modules.description: Create the IBM ROKS cluster and emit BNK registration outputs.

modules.name: cert-manager
modules.description: Install cert-manager into the newly created ROKS cluster.

modules.name: F5 Lifecycle Operator
modules.description: Install FLO into the newly created ROKS cluster after cert-manager is ready.

modules.name: CNEInstance
modules.description: Deploy a CNEInstance once FLO is ready. flo_trusted_profile_id and flo_cluster_issuer_name are auto-wired from the FLO module's outputs by the dependency graph.

modules.name: BNK License
modules.description: Apply the BNK License CR after CNEInstance is up. Pulls the F5 subscription JWT from the configured IBM COS bucket.
